I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message. I told him I'm treating the 18 August Osprey deadline as an unconfirmed rumour.

I found nothing about an Osprey rollout or that date for Quarrendon Freight Lines. I only checked what Tobias can see himself: his channels and the public files. Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account owned by Dana Okafor, so I told him to confirm the date with her before anyone plans around it.
